Alex studies the economics of artificial intelligence and technological change, as well as behavioral economics and mental representations in decision-making. Co-author, with Richard Thaler, of The Winner’s Curse: Behavioral Economics Anomalies, Then and Now.

Alex regularly writes essays on AI, technology, and economics on Substack at Ghosts of Electricity ↗.
Alex runs the AGI Economics Lab at Google DeepMind ↗.
